notes: «كلهم عن عبدة» converges three co-transmitters; the names after it are the shared tail, ending at Aisha
«- قال زهير حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، -» is Muslim's own variant naming Zuhayr's teacher in full: a variant group, not a route
«قالت نفست أسماء بنت عميس» is Aisha's report, so she is the last link; Asma is not a link
